interpretation.objective: Implement interactive manual-PV planning over pinned canonical or explicitly fetched exploratory Estonian source context, with shared browser/batch solar, consumption and storage engines, private household CSV import, and scenario PDF reports.

assumptions.statement: The initial 30 × 12 m, 20 kWp array is a hypothetical planning scenario, not an observed PV installation or suitability recommendation.
assumptions.rationale: Issue #4 requests manual polygon planning; the open-surface patch was selected from the frozen DSM without inferring rights or engineering suitability.

assumptions.statement: All metric geometry and horizon distances use EPSG:3301; GeoJSON coordinates are WGS84 longitude, latitude.
assumptions.rationale: Estonia's projected CRS supports metre-based calculations without Web Mercator area distortion.

assumptions.statement: Hourly ERA5 weather is a grid estimate shared across this bounded pilot; it is not site-measured irradiance.
assumptions.rationale: No owner irradiance or production observations were provided.

assumptions.statement: The frozen 5 m DSM/DTM download is not asserted contemporaneous with either 2024 or 2025.
assumptions.rationale: Per-cell LiDAR acquisition dates are not exposed by the selected WCS response.

assumptions.statement: Local shadows use equal-weight polygon receiver samples and a 500 m DSM horizon at 2° azimuth intervals, with 2 m mounting height initially.
assumptions.rationale: A bounded horizon approximation captures major buildings and vegetation while remaining interactive; module electrical mismatch is outside scope.

assumptions.statement: Surplus export revenue is exported kWh / 1000 × (EE spot EUR/MWh − sales margin); on-site PV avoids imports at spot price plus the explicit import adder.
assumptions.rationale: The extended planning scenario separates self-consumption value from surplus sales; the original all-generation-export comparison is retained and labeled.

assumptions.statement: All source and model timestamps use UTC interval starts; weather radiation averages are aligned by the acquisition transformation.
assumptions.rationale: Explicit interval semantics prevent the one-hour radiation shift and daylight-saving duplicate hours.

assumptions.statement: The canonical consumption assumption is 10 kWh during local daytime 07:00–23:00 and 4 kWh during the remaining local night, in Europe/Tallinn.
assumptions.rationale: No household measurements were supplied; this explicit editable planning profile supports on-site use estimates without presenting assumed demand as observations.

assumptions.statement: The canonical import-price adder is 0 EUR/MWh, so avoided import cost uses spot prices only; VAT and grid fees are not assumed.
assumptions.rationale: Actual retail and network contracts were not supplied. A configurable adder remains an explicitly user-entered scenario assumption.

assumptions.statement: PV and demand are matched on the model time axis for the comparison without storage; optional battery dispatch is reported separately. Missing uploaded demand remains unknown unless estimate filling is explicitly enabled.
assumptions.rationale: Imports, exports and self-use must balance while preserving uncertainty and partial profile coverage.

assumptions.statement: Uploaded household consumption is processed in browser memory and excluded from the repository and PDF reports; a user-initiated scenario export may explicitly include the normalized profile.
assumptions.rationale: The public canonical baseline contains only a generic estimate, not personal household observations.

assumptions.statement: A downloaded scenario PDF describes the current modeled scenario and its limitations; the published canonical PDF uses the pinned baseline and canonical run time.
assumptions.rationale: The report is a reviewable view over the analysis, and does not validate a scenario or establish financial returns.

assumptions.statement: The canonical source AOI remains the pinned Tartu pilot. Another selected Estonian area loads its own bounded terrain and weather context and remains exploratory, with request-time provenance.
assumptions.rationale: Tartu terrain and weather cannot establish shading or weather at another location; live request hashes do not substitute for retained raw source pins.

assumptions.statement: Storage is explicitly disabled in the canonical baseline. Optional historical dispatch uses configured capacity, charge/discharge limits, efficiency, reserve, permitted grid charging/export and cycling cost, with finite state resolution and historical price knowledge.
assumptions.rationale: Storage results are separate from the comparison without storage; perfect historical information does not establish live achievable returns or a recommended battery size.

assumptions.statement: Automatic battery capacity is twice PV kWp in kWh; the canonical 20 kWp array therefore proposes 40 kWh while storage remains disabled.
assumptions.rationale: The multiplier is an explicit editable scenario assumption, not an engineering or investment recommendation.

warnings.statement: Energy is an uncalibrated planning estimate from ERA5 and a 5 m horizon model; no owner production field validation was possible.
warnings.mitigation: Inspect source provenance and methodology before using the planning estimate.

warnings.statement: DSM catalog metadata describes acquisition campaigns in 2017–2020; exact cell dates are unknown. The frozen 5 m surface may differ from 2024/2025 and omits small objects, seasonal foliage and electrical mismatch.
warnings.mitigation: Inspect source provenance and methodology before using the planning estimate.

warnings.statement: The retained canonical source context is a 2 × 2 km Tartu pilot. Another selected Estonian area loads its own bounded source context and remains exploratory; missing context is not extrapolated from Tartu.
warnings.mitigation: Inspect source provenance and methodology before using the planning estimate.

warnings.statement: Energy value uses explicit consumption and price assumptions; optional storage is a separate historical dispatch comparison. Figures exclude taxes, unentered grid charges, curtailment and financing. The default import adder is zero, and 2025 quarter-hour prices are averaged hourly.
warnings.mitigation: Inspect source provenance and methodology before using the planning estimate.

warnings.statement: Elering price-data reuse licensing was not verified in the public API documentation; source attribution and the unresolved status are retained.
warnings.mitigation: Inspect source provenance and methodology before using the planning estimate.

warnings.statement: Aerial PV detection and installation-level government reconciliation are not evaluated; available government data are municipality aggregates.
warnings.mitigation: Inspect source provenance and methodology before using the planning estimate.

warnings.statement: The published 10 kWh day / 4 kWh night household demand is an estimate, not a measured household profile. Partial CSV imports do not establish full-year demand or savings.
warnings.mitigation: Use a complete, correctly interpreted Enefit consumption export and enter actual import-price components before assessing household savings.

warnings.statement: Optional battery dispatch uses historical price knowledge, finite state resolution and explicit losses/limits; storage is disabled in the canonical baseline. The model excludes battery investment and does not guarantee trading returns.
warnings.mitigation: Review demand coverage, operating assumptions and the comparison without storage; evaluate actual equipment and tariffs before investment.
